verdict.rationale: Firestore's docs only describe chained filters/sorting and a MongoDB-compatible API in an Enterprise tier (firebase-docs-2, firebase-docs-4/16/27), not joins, relational constraints, or multi-table transactions in the SQL sense. Hands-on community feedback directly contradicts any claim of rich relational querying: users call Firebase 'notorious for having an unintuitive lack of server-side query options' and note missing basic features like count queries, wanting a 'deeper querying language' (firebase-comm-8, firebase-comm-18, firebase-comm-19). Missing for 10: documented join syntax, foreign-key-style constraints, and cross-document ACID transaction docs, plus resolution of the community-reported query limitations.
